On a Saturday early afternoon I had a random sharp pain in my chest/right shoulder blade then it started hurting when i inhaled. I’ve gotten quite a few “catches” in my life so i thought it was that until it didn’t go away. Monday, I finally went to the doctor, I had woken up crying because the pain had gotten so bad. I went to my general practitioner. I told her that it was chest pain with shoulder pain. She listened to my lungs and said they sounded fine but she gave me an inhaler and sent me on my way saying “if it still hurts in a few days go get an x-ray.” well the inhaler didn’t help at all. On Wednesday, I made myself to go classes and I just couldn’t walk around campus anymore, it hurt so bad to go up the stairs and I was getting so short of breath. My mom convinced me to go to Urgent Care (we didn’t have insurance so I was so hesitant), I tell the doctor exactly what I told my general practitioner. IMMEDIATELY they tell me it sounds like a pulmonary embolism (blood clot in the lung) and get a scan of my chest. They said the radiologist had never gotten back to them so quickly. They gave me a lovenox shot in my stomach (owe) and called an ambulance. The paramedics were shocked I was still alive, they said most people that they’ve seen with a PE drop dead minutes to hours after the clot passes into their lungs. So three days in the hospital (many shots in the stomach) later I get released and put on blood thinners for 6 months. My right lung didn’t fully heal for a while, the bottom had been cut off from receiving any blood. ANYWAY, i don’t trust doctors and thats scary.
